discriminating_terms: a suspicion of truth in it
attributions.rationale: “a suspicion of truth in it” presents truth as a faint quality present in the tale, matching sense:003. Sense:002 would express mistrust toward a person, claim, or motive; the tale is described as containing a trace of truth, not as distrusting truth.

“remained under suspicion” frames the contractor as the person suspected of wrongdoing, matching sense:001. Sense:002 would describe a stance of distrust toward the contractor or a claim; this construction presents the contractor as the suspected actor.

discriminating_terms: a suspicion that the cashier had altered the sales records
attributions.rationale: “a suspicion that the cashier had altered the sales records” supplies a proposition alleging an act of wrongdoing by the cashier, matching sense:001. Sense:002 could describe general distrust of the cashier, but the complement specifically identifies suspected record alteration.

“a suspicion of a smile” means a faint suggestion of a smile present in the reply, matching sense:003. Sense:002 would express distrust of the reply or its speaker; the phrase instead treats the smile as a barely perceptible quality.

discriminating_terms: regarded the sudden policy change with suspicion
attributions.rationale: “regarded the sudden policy change with suspicion” describes residents viewing the change skeptically, matching sense:002. Sense:001 would attribute possible wrongdoing to a suspected actor; here suspicion is the residents’ attitude toward the policy change, with no alleged act by a person.

discriminating_terms: no longer trusted the officials' explanation
attributions.rationale: “no longer trusted the officials' explanation” explicitly makes distrust of an explanation the relevant relation, matching sense:002. Sense:001 would involve suspecting someone of a particular crime or wrongdoing; loss of trust in the explanation alone does not assert that.

“on suspicion of fraud” gives the suspected wrongdoing that grounds the arrests, matching sense:001. Sense:002 would describe mistrust toward a person, organization, or claim; this frame identifies suspected fraud as the alleged act.
